module.purpose: Defines the exported authentication error-code enumeration used to identify and serialize auth-related failure conditions consistently across the application.
module.summary: This module centralizes stable string identifiers for authentication, account access, two-factor authentication, backup-code, identity-provider, password, verification, rate-limit, and internal-server failures. Consumers can use the enum to avoid duplicating literal error strings while preserving consistent external error representations.
module.businessContext: Supports authentication and account-security flows by standardizing errors exposed to users and clients. Incorrect values can break error handling, localization, API responses, or security-flow branching.
classes: ErrorCode (~L1-19): Enumerates stable authentication and account error identifiers

The error-code collection is exported for use by other modules.

assumptions.description: Consumers treat the assigned string values as stable identifiers for authentication error handling.
